components.css: .ds-gear { background: var(--panel, #F6F6F6); border-radius: 20px; padding: 12px 16px 14px; } .ds-gear-main { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; } .ds-plate { position: relative; flex: none; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--ground, #FFF); } .ds-crest { position: absolute; right: -6px; bottom: -6px; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--ground, #FFF); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--panel, #F6F6F6); } .ds-gear-text { display: grid; min-width: 0; font: 400 13px/1.375 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #5E5E5E); } .ds-gear-text small { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-gear-text b { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink, #000); } .ds-gear-text em { font: 700 14px Inter, sans-serif; font-style: normal; color: var(--ink, #000); } .ds-sockets { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; padding-left: 68px; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-socket { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px 0 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px dashed var(--rule-strong, #AFAFAF); font: 400 13px 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #5E5E5E); } .ds-socket.on { border: 0; background: var(--ground, #FFF); color: var(--ink, #000); font-weight: 500; }

components.css: .ds-skill { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 56px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 60px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--panel, #F6F6F6); border-radius: 20px; } .ds-skill-name { font: 700 15px 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #000); } .ds-pips { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-pips i { width: 18px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--cell, #E2E2E2); } .ds-pips i.on { background: #E5484D; animation: ds-pip 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-pip { from { transform: scale(0.2); opacity: 0; } } .ds-total { text-align: right; font: 800 22px/1 Inter, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-total small { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2, #5E5E5E); }

narrative.northStar: 黑白野外工具 Black & White Field Kit
narrative.overview:
A build checked on a phone between hunts, outdoors, one-handed. The interface is a field kit rather than a dashboard: a white page (black at night) carrying a short stack of filled grey cards, every heading set heavy and large, every number set big and black. Nothing decorates; hierarchy comes from weight, size and whitespace, and the one action that matters on a screen is the single black pill.

Colour is withheld everywhere except one place: skill categories. Each skill's level is a row of rounded pips filled in its official category colour (attack red, element blue, action amber, defense green, resistance grey), so the skill board is the only colourful thing on a black-and-white screen and reads at a glance. Official equipment art and monster crests are the only imagery; they sit on soft filled tiles.

Motion is the app part of the kit: pages cross-fade through View Transitions, sheets and toasts rise on springs (motion-v), level pips pop in when gear changes, and everything animates through transform and opacity only. Loading shows skeletons, and saving or deleting a build updates the list at once.
keyCharacteristics: White ground and filled grey cards by day; black ground and charcoal cards by night, everything inverted.
One black pill per screen for the primary action; grey pills for everything else.
Large radii: 20px cards, 28px sheets, fully round chips, pills and pips.
Noto Sans TC 900 headings; Inter tabular figures for every number.
Skill category colour only as level pips and small dots.
Springs and cross-fades on transform/opacity; skeletons while loading.

rules.name: The Category-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Hue appears only to encode a skill's category: pips, dots, the legend. Never on buttons, borders, backgrounds, headings or icons.

rules.name: The One Black Pill Rule
rules.body: One filled primary per screen. A second action that competes is grey, and a primary that yields its role (分享連結 while auto-build is open) turns grey rather than doubling up.

rules.name: The Inverse Selection Rule
rules.body: Selected and on states invert to the shell surface; they are never shown with an accent tint.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Colour Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from size and weight; never from coloured text.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Every number uses the numeral face with tabular figures so values align in columns.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element is temporarily above the page (sheet, toast, sliding thumb). Cards and buttons never cast one.

dos: Do keep each screen to one black pill; demote competing actions to grey pills.
Do colour skills only through skillColor() (pips, dots, legend).
Do set every number in the Inter .stamp style.
Do animate with transform and opacity only, with springs for sheets, toasts and pips, and honour reduced motion.
Do show skeletons while client-only data (saved builds, the current build) loads.
donts: Don't reintroduce the steel/forge palette, temper colours or the condensed stamped numerals.
Don't add borders or shadows to cards, or nest cards inside cards.
Don't use accent-coloured text, buttons or backgrounds.
Don't transition colours, sizes or layout properties.
